hotels.title: Coastal Victoria Bestselling Escape near Phillip Island with Daily Breakfast & Two Heated Onsite Pools.
hotels.description: Whether you're looking for summer sun or a cosy winter retreat, Silverwater Resort promises the very best of regional Victoria just minutes from iconic Phillip Island, with panoramic views over San Remo and the Bass Coast. The resort boasts a range of accommodation options - from well-appointed resort rooms to self-contained one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments with private terraces or balconies. Indulge in fresh cuisine at Watermark Restaurant, offering stunning views through floor-to-ceiling windows, or sip sophisticated drinks at the onsite Lounge Bar. Unwind by one of two heated onsite pools, or opt for the spa pool or steam room while the kids are kept busy with the onsite jumping pillows, games room and playground. From the resort, you're perfectly placed to explore the Bass Coast. A short drive takes you to Phillip Island Wildlife Park, where you can spot sleepy koalas napping in the eucalyptus trees or hand-feed the kangaroos and wallabies. Don't miss the Penguin Parade at dusk, watching as hundreds of penguins make their way ashore.
